test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

The thin wire that giving off light is called the filament.
solution:
The correct answer is** __that giving off.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
The above given sentence is in **simple present tense**, the rule for which is **Subject + Verb in the base form/third person plural form + the rest of the sentence. **Therefore the sentence should be *“The thin wire that gives off light is called the filament.”*

 
 
• Hence the** correct answer is option 1) that giving off**
